newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS-factors to watch - Sept 26.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS-factors to watch - Sept 26.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors affecting Indian stock markets on Thursday morning.
** Court takes up former Prime Minister P.V. Narasimha Rao's request for anticipatory bail fearing arrest in the Lakhubhai Pathak cheating case
** The Industry Ministry clears 63 foreign direct investment proposals amounting to 54.1 billion rupees, the Business Line reports
The proposals relate to software, engineering,
electronics, power cotton and synthetic yarn, floriculture, financial services, medical services and pharmaceuticals
** The spot dollar/rupee INR= opened little changed at 35.67/68 per dollar and seen range-bound, dealers say
** On Wednesday, Indian shares closed mixed after profit-taking wiped out strong early gains, brokers said
** The 30-share Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) index .BSESN closed 6.19 points, or 0.19 percent, higher at 3,343.92
** The 100-share National index .NATEX added 1.91 points, or 0.13 percent, at 1,492.97
** The 500-share CRISIL index was off 0.92 points, or 0.14 percent, at 649.64
** The Calcutta index .CALSN fell 4.14 points to 426.13
** The Madras index .MDSI firmed 2.63 points to 3,421.32
** The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR Index JCEAI slipped 0.67 points, or 0.98 percent, to 67.99 with the premium over the local market at 12.26 percent
